breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that applying both an adiabatic (zero heat flux) and a fixed temperature condition to the same surface (x=0) is contradictory. It resolved this by creating a well-posed problem where the fixed temperature is at x=0 and the adiabatic condition is at the other side of the wall, x=L. This aligns with the primary solution suggested in the ground truth.
